title: Graph reinforcement learning for dynamic flexible job shop scheduling under composite disturbances with a schedule-stability budget: reproducibility package
description:
Reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript "Graph reinforcement learning for dynamic flexible job shop scheduling under composite disturbances with a schedule-stability budget", prepared for The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology. This record describes software and supporting research assets, not an accepted or published journal article.

The package includes event-driven scheduling code, reused synthetic FJSP instances, frozen checkpoints, protocols, and archived experimental summaries. Author-owned code and checkpoints are Apache-2.0; original experimental results and protocol documentation are CC BY 4.0. Inherited material retains its applicable terms. See LICENSE_SCOPE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; the primary software-license metadata does not replace asset-specific terms.
